title: SSC CPO SI CAPF Online Form 2026 (1871 Posts)
intro: Short Information : Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released a Notification for the post of Sub Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces Examination, 2026 on the official website of SSC. This recruitment was released for 1871 posts. Applications for the SSC CPO SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 has Started from 10 September 2026, & Candidate can apply until 30 September 2026. Candidates must check complete details for SSC CPO SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 from the link given below.
applicationFee: Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
